item.title: Q-Score — Stability Vector and Flow Direction
item.description:
Q-Score — Stability Vector and Flow Direction

In Antigravity Cosmology: Force Field Stability / System Pressure Vector. In Classical Language: An integrated short-term indicator of net aggressive order flow direction and momentum (Order Flow & Tape Kinematics).

What Q-Score Really Is

Q-Score is a deterministic mathematical function analyzing real-time tape prints, aggressive volume velocity (CVD), and immediate price reaction.

The score oscillates between negative values (selling pressure dominance) and positive values (buying pressure dominance). The numerical scale reflects the density and consistency of aggressive market orders.
